caption: Joins combine columns side by side; union() stacks rows top to bottom.

eyebrow: Columns match by POSITION -- a real risk
code:
df_a = spark.createDataFrame([(1, "x")], ["id", "name"])
df_b = spark.createDataFrame([("y", 2)], ["name", "id"])

df_a.union(df_b).show()
# id and name silently SWAPPED for df_b's rows -- no error
caption: union() matches by position, not name -- a genuine silent-data-corruption risk.

code:
all_trips = january.unionByName(february)

# matches columns by NAME instead of position
caption: Sidesteps the silent-swap risk entirely — the safer choice for real files.
